commit_subject: Fixed the probe hallucination at the scorer rather than the prompt (three prompt attempts cost 8 detections and were reverted), taking detection to 96.7% with FPR steady at 3.3% — then built and ran the Phase  7 eight-vector benchmark, whose first result I had to withdraw after finding the egress allowlist intercepts 6 of 8 vectors, making every arm equal by construction.
